usage: dataset_dvwa_adapter.py [-h]

Local-only adapter for replaying integrated dataset POCs against the DVWA lab.
The generated POCs use dataset sample paths (for example ``/025.php``), while
the PHP lab exposes category routes. This adapter translates only those local
sample paths and forwards HTTP requests to the isolated DVWA container. It
never accepts non-local clients and never executes scripts.

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
